situation.english: A student loses their bursary due to academic performance. They have M1,000 saved and monthly expenses of M1,500. What should they do?
situation.sesotho: Moithuti o lahlehetswe ke bursary. O na le M1,000 e bolokilweng le ditshenyehelo tsa M1,500 ka kgwedi. O etse eng?

advice.english: First, cut all non-essential spending. Find part-time work quickly. Apply for other funding. The M1,000 is a buffer for 2-3 weeks.
advice.sesotho: Pele, fokotsa tshebediso e sa hlokahaleng. Fumana mosebetsi wa nakwana. Kopa dithuso tse ding. M1,000 ke buffer ya dibeke tse 2-3.

lesson.english: Emergency funds buy you time during crises.
lesson.sesotho: Matlole a tshohanyetso a o reka nako mathateng.

situation.english: A friend asks to borrow M200 and promises to repay next month. You know they already owe others money. What should you do?
situation.sesotho: Motswalle o kopa M200 mme o tshepisa ho kgutlisa kgwedi e tlang. O tseba hore o se a kolota batho ba bang. O etse eng?

advice.english: Politely decline or lend only what you can afford to lose. Never lend money you need for your own expenses.
advice.sesotho: Hana ka mosa kapa alima feela seo o ka se lahlehelwang. O se ke wa alima chelete eo o e hlokang.

lesson.english: Protect your financial wellbeing, even with friends.
lesson.sesotho: Sireletsa bophelo ba hao ba lichelete, le ho metswalle.

situation.english: You spent M400 on entertainment and now have only M100 for food for two weeks. What went wrong and how do you fix it?
situation.sesotho: O sebedisitse M400 boithabisong mme o setse le M100 bakeng sa dijo dibeke tse pedi. Ho senyehile eng?

advice.english: You prioritized wants over needs. Fix: Buy basic food (rice, mealie meal). Avoid entertainment until next month.
advice.sesotho: O behile ditakatso pele ho ditlhoko. Fix: Reka dijo tsa motheo. Qoba boithabiso ho fihlela kgwedi e tlang.

lesson.english: Always budget for needs before spending on wants.
lesson.sesotho: Dula o rera ditlhoko pele o sebedisa ditakatso.

situation.english: Your phone breaks and you need it for school. Repairs cost M500 but you only have M200 saved.
situation.sesotho: Fono ya hao e senyehile mme o e hloka bakeng sa sekolo. Ho lokisa M500 empa o bolokile M200 feela.

advice.english: This is why emergency funds matter. Borrow M300 from family (interest-free) or find temporary work. Next time, save more.
advice.sesotho: Ke ka hona matlole a tshohanyetso a le bohlokwa. Alima M300 lelapeng kapa fumana mosebetsi wa nakwana.

lesson.english: Emergency funds should cover unexpected repairs.
lesson.sesotho: Matlole a tshohanyetso a lokela ho akaretsa ditokiso tse sa lebellwang.
